turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How are things going in Portland today? How has your lower back been feeling lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's actually a bit better today. For my workout, I stuck to doing my physical therapy stretches, which really helped loosen things up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great to hear. Taking it easy and focusing on those PT exercises is definitely the way to go. Did you have a good start to your morning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did. I kept it simple and had a protein smoothie for breakfast before heading out the door. It was quick and kept me full.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A protein smoothie is always a solid, quick option. How is Olive doing? Is she keeping you company while you recover?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's doing great. Mostly just napping in the sun on the living room rug. She doesn't mind me being a bit slower moving at all.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Cats are excellent lounging partners! Do you have any plans for the rest of your evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a quiet night. Grace and I are planning to unwind on the couch and watch a nature documentary.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A nature documentary sounds like a perfect way to relax. Have you been able to do any woodworking or tennis lately, or are you still resting up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No tennis for a while until my back is 100%, but I'm hoping to get back into the garage for some light woodworking this weekend if I keep feeling better.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move to hold off on tennis, but hopefully you can get some shop time in. How is your neighbor's vegetable garden doing by the way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's coming along nicely! Grace and I chatted with them yesterday and they've got some sprouts coming up already.
